method: Independent visual review of all three desktop heroes, walkthrough panels and mobile heroes, plus Paper dark and Ink light

ranking.name: Paper & crimson
ranking.reason: Warm reading surface, clear primary actions and strongest continuity with CyberAlchemy’s coral identity.

ranking.name: Mist & cobalt
ranking.reason: Clean and readable; blue is less connected to the coral logo.

ranking.name: Ink & copper
ranking.reason: Striking; fine illustration lines and panel separation are less apparent.

finding: Dark-mode decorative knot is too faint, especially Ink.
correction: Dark knot stroke opacity raised from .57 to .82; layout, text and stroke geometry preserved.
scope: Aesthetic assessment; not participant research or accessibility certification.
follow_up: Reviewer inspected corrected Ink and Paper dark screenshots and confirmed the brighter strokes adequately address the concern; original ranking stands.
